summary: Southern First Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board of Directors authorized a share repurchase plan of up to $10.0 million of its common stock, approximately 2% of outstanding shares. Repurchases may occur via open market or privately negotiated transactions at management's discretion, subject to market conditions and legal requirements. No price per share, premium, or timeline was specified; the plan expires after August 23, 2027, unless renewed with Board and Federal Reserve approval. The company is not obligated to repurchase shares. Watch for execution pace and capital management implications.
